description: HOLLAND, MI. – According to WZZM 13, Michigan families will see $700 million in savings on their energy bills thanks to a new program finalized by the Department of Energy this past weekend, courtesy of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. But Tax Man Sean McCann promised to repeal the One Big Beautiful Bill as high first priority if he makes it…
